ns2:course.label: Ceramics Sculpture II
ns2:course.description: Students will develop more sophisticated techniques and processes necessary to develop their personal voice and take more responsibility for concept, process and material in their work. Emphasis will stress processes related to creating ceramic sculpture such as hand construction techniques, kiln firing, clay and glaze experimentation. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTS 210.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTS 210.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or New Media or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
